title: Account Assistant
description:
Role & responsibilities 
 Maintain day-to-day accounting entries in Tally/ERP and ensure proper documentation. Record sales, purchase, receipt, payment, journal, and expense transactions . Prepare and maintain invoices, vouchers, debit/credit notes, and supporting documents . Assist in bank reconciliation and monitor bank transactions. Maintain accounts receivable and payable and follow up on outstanding balances. Assist in GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance and maintain related records. Verify vendor bills, purchase invoices, and payment documents before processing. Assist in monthly closing, ledger scrutiny, and preparation of financial reports . Maintain proper filing and record-keeping of accounting documents. Coordinate with vendors, customers, banks, auditors, and internal departments regarding accounting matters. Assist the senior accountant in audit, taxation, and financial reporting requirements. Ensure accuracy, confidentiality, and timely completion of accounting work. 

 Share your CV on: 6287199732 (HR Manager)

Key Skills: Tally ERP,GST,Tally,TDS,Finance,General Accounting,Book Keeping,Accounts Finalisation
